F4-6a.notes_for_reviewers: A printed table of 32 drag runs, sideways on the page; the packet shows it turned upright. Each row of the checklist names a run and a column. Its picture shows the run number of that row at the left and, at the right, the column's heading above the cell; the row is boxed in blue in both. A: does the picture show that run and that column? B: does the cell read the value given, digit for digit, with the decimal point where it is printed? Fractions are written as printed (1 1/2 is one and a half). A digit with a break or a missing piece counts as printed if it can still be read with confidence; if it cannot, answer cannot tell and say why in C.
